results.content:
Tesla's flying Roadster demo is less a product launch than a credibility test for a car Musk first showed in 2017 and still hasn't shipped.

You've heard Elon Musk promise a flying Roadster before. This time, according to The Information's reporting as picked up by Electrek and Carscoops, Tesla is preparing to show the long-delayed sports car briefly lifting off the ground with SpaceX cold gas thrusters at a Texas test site. The target is August 2026 or later. That's close enough to matter.
results.title: Tesla Plans to Fly Its Roadster Using SpaceX Rocket Thrusters This Month - Startup Fortune
